page.overview:
Who is Hala?

Hala is a character appearing in the games, Pokémon Sun and Pokémon Moon. He is the Island Kahuna of Melemele Island who specializes in types. He is also the grandfather of the player character's rival, Hau.

Hala is a stocky old man, who has white hair tied in a short spiky ponytail similar to his grandson Hau, as well as white eyebrows and moustache. He wears a blue shirt under a long sleeve yellow haori with some large flower pattern, a white rope tied in a knot over a red fan with black guards and white a pattern. He also wears knee length white shorts and blue flip-flops with white straps. In addition, Hala has squinty eyes, Hala also wears white wrist band on the left hand's wrist.

Hala is a caring grandfather to Hau. He prefers fighting types and respects the player character's power. Hala is a bold and seasoned trainer, though he's fatter than the typical trainer of his type specialty, Hala makes up for it with his go-getting perseverance.

Hala is the Kahuna of Melemele Island. In order to go to Akala Island, the player character must defeat Totem Gumshoos/Alolan Raticate and then battle Hala. Once the player character defeats Hala, Hala registers Tauros to the player character's ride pager.
